title: Home practical guide and safety card: breathing rate
subject: Science
unit: Spring 2: The periodic table (8F); breathing and respiration (8C)
source: Written for science/y8 lesson 40 (Home practical guide and safety card: breathing rate (portal worksheet; gentle stepping on the bottom stair with an adult nearby, stop if unwell))
intro: Lesson 40: Anaerobic respiration in humans. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To see how exercise changes breathing rate
safety: Gentle stepping on the bottom stair with an adult nearby, stop if unwell
An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Sit quietly for 2 minutes; count breaths in 1 minute
Step gently on and off the bottom stair for 2 minutes
Count breaths in 1 minute straight away
Count again every minute until it returns to normal

questions.q: Big question: why keep panting after a sprint?
questions.a: To repay the oxygen debt by breaking down lactic acid.
